question: Should this internal test-runner-only PR receive a real-behavior proof override, given that exact-head UI and dependency checks pass but all supplied evidence is tests and CI?
rationale: The branch changes no product runtime behavior, so a separate user setup is not naturally demonstrable, but the external-PR policy does not treat tests and CI alone as sufficient proof.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: Accept exact-head hosted UI and dependency runs as the appropriate evidence for this internal test-isolation change, then wait for required checks before merge.

options.title: Request independent artifact
options.body: Keep the proof gate open until the contributor supplies an inspectable non-test terminal, log, or linked artifact showing the retained-module failure and corrected result.
